candidates.change_summary: Replace require(((balances[msg.sender] + msg.value) >= balances[msg.sender])) with require(balances[msg.sender] + msg.value >= balances[msg.sender], "No overflow"); but keep logic same — not a valid mutant because it's equivalent. Instead, change the addition to subtraction to cause balance decrease.
Replace balances[msg.sender] += msg.value with balances[msg.sender] -= msg.value, so deposit decreases caller's balance.
Replace the require expression with require(balances[msg.sender] >= msg.value) so deposit fails if balance not large enough, changing when it updates.
Delete the require statement, allowing overflow on deposit.
Delete the Log.AddMessage call, so no log happens but balances still update.
Replace msg.sender with a constant address (address(0)) in the balance update, so all deposits go to address(0).
